verdict.approved_object: One fixed actual-Adam body displacement, old/new hard and new fixed-old-event trajectories, frozen original head, same mature state and real fit32/following32.
verdict.necessity: The existing report already establishes fixed-event fit descent and local hard-event reversal. The missing object is its causal motor-to-probability contrast: where that particular contrast is attenuated and whether surviving logits align with its actual targets.
verdict.sufficiency: Three trajectories plus per-point numerical repeats distinguish resolved read-stage geometric attenuation from adverse current-head task alignment for this direction and these targets. These phenomena may coexist.
verdict.scope_choice: Do not add the proposed negative-SG direction/scales. That is needed only for optimizer-versus-proxy attribution, which this first trace explicitly leaves open.
verdict.launch_gate: Design only. A separate immutable preregistration, independent implementation review, source/data/code locks and idle-device resource gate must pass before any new execution.

fixed_estimand.B: Reconstructed ordinary saved-Adam actual post-clamp body displacement at scale1; original head and bias restored; native hard events.
fixed_estimand.C: Exactly B parameters and same original head/bias, but force every A begin-motor and finish-body event. Remaining COBA/ALIF/STP/delay dynamics evolve normally.
fixed_estimand.fit_start: Same complete source entering physical state for A/B/C and every replay.
fixed_estimand.following_start: Same OLD-parameter A-fit terminal complete state for every trajectory/replay; a B/C-produced fit terminal is never substituted.
fixed_estimand.state_lineage: Preserve all h/ring/ge/gi/b/x/u/baseline/h_mean and empty DAN/Gamma fields, saved life counters, RNG and both optimizer moment sets in the disposable reconstruction. Production/source remains unchanged.
fixed_estimand.meaning: A conditional finite-parameter replay, distinct from deployment with a continuously changed body or primary active-learning evaluation.

minimum_budget.no_additional_tape_only_pass: Capture A masks within the registered A forwards. Telemetry/CPU algebra must not re-integrate a physical tick.
minimum_budget.repeat_role: One full duplicate of each fit/following parameter/event point; no outcomes chosen from repeats. Any stage or hard-mask instability makes attribution ambiguous.
minimum_budget.hard_ceiling: Stop after this bounded trace. No extra windows, direction/scales search, second Adam reconstruction or recovery without a new reviewed execution amendment.

reconstruction_gate.procedure: Use the original learner.observe(fit32), both source Adam states, original raw gradient, unchanged global clipping, both AdamW steps and original edge clamps. Stage real FP32 parameters with bounded CPU/disk chunks. Restore old head/bias before all B/C traces.
required_accounting: Raw full/body gradient norms and SG dot actual post-clamp displacement
Actual body/head/bias displacement norms and changed-coordinate counts
Reconstructed observe scores and every terminal physical field versus A fit
B hard-fit/following risks and hard-mask change counts versus immutable prior body_1 control
C fixed-event fit risk versus immutable prior fixed-event body_1 control
reconstruction_gate.comparison_floors: Register quantity-specific FP32 relative/absolute precision floors and known original replay error before launch. Norm/dot reproduction must use relative scales plus recorded reduction error, not a generic1-unit tolerance for tiny quantities. Risk reproduction uses prior and current replay floors.
reconstruction_gate.lineage_limit: Removed displacement/tape bytes cannot be hash-compared. Matching reconstruction program, state/moments/RNG and recorded norms/dots/clamps/risks/counts establishes audited reconstruction conformance, not a claim of independent bitwise proof of every removed coordinate.
reconstruction_gate.stop: If reconstruction conformance fails, do not interpret attenuation or alignment and do not substitute a newly convenient direction.

native_causal_observables.timestamp: Before accepting the current target, using the same prepared old-state arrival context as the issued prediction.
record: Effective motor threshold and begin threshold margin
Native motor transmitted STP pulse p
Actual RMSNorm output z with gain and effective epsilon
Actual current-head logits and per-target CE
native_causal_observables.pulse_equation: u_active=u_old+u0*(1-u_old)*s; p=min((u_active*x_old/norm)*s,3). Use the actual source parameters/old motor STP fields; no second integration or alternative learning equation.
native_causal_observables.pulse_identity: Because sensory and motor are disjoint, the sealed motor spike/pulse must agree with finish motor spike/committed ring pulse before current-target drive can reach motor. Validate against the original commit; failure blocks attribution.
native_causal_observables.full_event_tape: Every begin-motor and finish-body SpikeFn call, stage/order/mask/margin:64 calls per32-event window. C uses the corresponding A fit/following tape, never the other window tape.
native_causal_observables.full_state_repeats: Compare every terminal field and each of four ring slots; compare every collected intermediate motor/read/logit array and all hard masks on each repeated parameter point.
native_causal_observables.resources: Stream CPU/disk telemetry in bounded chunks. Do not hold full extra decoder/gradient/device snapshots. Do not launch while another GPU model is active.

exact_probability_accounting.gauge: Center each issued logit contrast across vocabulary to remove the scalar softmax gauge; keep centered raw norms distinct from probability changes.
exact_probability_accounting.formula: For reference logits a_F and changed logits a_H, delta=a_H-a_F, p_F=softmax(a_F), A=delta_y-E_pF[delta]. Exactly CE_H-CE_F=KL(p_F||p_H)-A.
exact_probability_accounting.numerics: Compute FP64 log_softmax/logsumexp, target gain, expected delta and KL stably; cross-check exact CE difference per target and window. Do not exponentiate uncentered large logits or clamp KL/loss residuals to create a biological effect. Tiny negative numerical KL is reported with its floor; materially negative KL invalidates the computation.
exact_probability_accounting.decision: Resolved A>0 is target alignment; resolved KL-A>0 is adverse finite risk. Favorable alignment can coexist with larger curvature cost. Neither voltage norm nor spike count substitutes for these signed task terms.
exact_probability_accounting.common_vs_content: For actual update/event delta logits, report mean-delta and centered-time residual. Split the linear alignment using whole-window empirical means and covariance; retain exact total KL. Optionally compute shared-only CE offline from reference logits+mean(delta), with total-minus-shared as an order-defined interaction-containing residual. This costs no physical forwards.
exact_probability_accounting.common_limit: This is retrospective accounting. A near-common baseline head does not establish that the update-induced contrast is common; shared-only CE is not a legal new online predictor or a unigram capability comparison.

attenuation_rules.field_resolution: For each field coordinate/summary, tau_X=max(predeclared FP32 error bound for that computation,10*maximum repeat error over all A/B/C points). Register scale conventions before execution; use each field own physical/coordinate units. Discrete hard masks must repeat exactly.
attenuation_rules.risk_resolution: Use tau_L=max(predeclared stable CE/decomposition error bound,10*largest risk/decomposition replay error across all registered points). Keep this separate from stage-field floors and reconstruction floors.
attenuation_rules.resolved_contrast: Upstream/downstream differences must be compared with their own floors. No universal variation-fraction threshold is supplied.
attenuation_rules.reset: A resolved paired v/s/p contrast with h contrast below its resolved floor is a witness of geometric loss at the implemented post-reset observable. Partial-coordinate witnesses and whole-vector loss are reported separately; this does not certify lost target information.
attenuation_rules.projection: Report delta_h and exact W_read*delta_h; if a projection-null claim is made, use a numerically audited row/null-space decomposition with a preregistered rank tolerance and conditioning report. Raw ||delta_r||/||delta_h|| alone is coordinate-scale dependent and is not a scale-invariant bottleneck claim.
attenuation_rules.normalization: Separate projected radial/directional differences and compute the actual finite RMSNorm map with gain/epsilon. Report output attenuation against the exact finite map and repeat floors; a local Jacobian is descriptive for finite event jumps.
attenuation_rules.decoder_alignment: If resolved z/centered-logit contrasts survive but their exact signed task effect is adverse or unresolved, this supports current-head local alignment/calibration weakness rather than absence of upstream variation.
attenuation_rules.mixed_result: Report coexisting losses/alignment and unresolved stages. Do not force a single winner from three coupled trajectories.

binding_next_action.geometric_witness: A resolved geometric-loss witness makes that read stage eligible for a separately reviewed matched read-surface/head-calibration comparison. It does not select a new observable or mandate production replacement.
binding_next_action.adverse_event_alignment: If B-C remains resolved and adverse while read-stage contrasts survive, retain event/read task alignment as a local candidate explanation. SG-versus-Adam and unique reset/optimizer attribution remain open.
binding_next_action.beneficial_event_alignment: If B-C is favorable or within its new floor, withdraw the claim of an adverse event effect for that registered window; retain measured stage geometry only.
binding_next_action.failure_or_ambiguity: Mark reconstruction/interface/nonfinite/memory/replay failure as invalid or ambiguous. Stop without architecture adoption, broader search or negative capability conclusion.
excluded_claims: SG is globally wrong or Adam moments are the unique cause
Current direction identifies the long-run plateau
Exact full-history gradient or native biological event-credit law
Independent generalization/convergence/capability gain from64 reused targets
binding_next_action.affirmative_scope: The valid output is one audited finite event/read contrast, its geometric propagation and signed current-head task effect on two fixed real OWT windows.
